requirements.title: Authenticated identity
requirements.acceptance: Verify a real account and derive its role and school from trusted server-side identity; logout invalidates the session.

requirements.title: Object authorization
requirements.acceptance: Reject cross-school access, unassigned teacher access and unrelated guardian/student access on every read and write.

requirements.title: School management
requirements.acceptance: An authorized administrator creates, reads and updates a school; required name validation and persistence are demonstrated.

requirements.title: User administration
requirements.acceptance: Provision/disable users and assign only approved school roles; class teacher selection resolves to a valid same-school teacher.

requirements.title: Student records
requirements.acceptance: Create and update a student with valid school, name, birth date, admission number and grade; reject duplicates and unauthorized changes.

requirements.title: Guardian relationships
requirements.acceptance: Create a guardian and link approved same-school students; repeated linking is safe and unauthorized links are rejected.

requirements.title: Courses and classes
requirements.acceptance: Create a course and a term class with valid same-school course and teacher; display a persisted roster.

requirements.title: Enrolment lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Enrol a student once in a compatible class, then withdraw or complete without erasing history.

requirements.title: Attendance
requirements.acceptance: Save one status per class/student/date, reload it and correct it with attributable history; identify partial failures.

requirements.title: Assessments/results
requirements.acceptance: Create an assessment and record only enrolled student results within 0..maxScore, using the approved grade policy and attributable corrections.

requirements.title: Report publication
requirements.acceptance: Create a private term draft, publish with approved authority and expose it only to authorized family/student accounts.

requirements.title: In-app notifications
requirements.acceptance: Store publication notices against the guardian user account; recipients read and mark only their own notices; retry avoids duplicate notices.

requirements.title: Search and lists
requirements.acceptance: Authorized filters/search return matching scoped records with bounded, deterministic pagination.

requirements.title: Role views
requirements.acceptance: Admin, teacher, guardian and student views complete the approved journeys without dead links or inaccessible required functions.

requirements.title: Privacy and audit
requirements.acceptance: Log actor/action/time/object for sensitive changes without record bodies or secrets; implement approved retention and correction policy.

requirements.title: Recovery
requirements.acceptance: Restore a synthetic backup in an isolated environment and demonstrate integrity plus approved recovery objectives.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.acceptance: Complete primary journeys with keyboard and screen reader; evaluate WCAG 2.2 AA as the proposed acceptance standard.

requirements.title: Reliability and errors
requirements.acceptance: Use consistent 400/401/403/404/409/500 contracts; mutation retry/concurrency cannot silently corrupt records.

requirements.title: Performance
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate bounded list queries and an agreed response-time/concurrency target using realistic synthetic school volumes.

requirements.title: Release control
requirements.acceptance: Record revision, migration state, environment and evidence; deploy only after acceptance and rehearse rollback without losing confirmed data.
